$comment: Remote rendezvous/relay node list for TurtleLauncher's Friends/LAN play (Terracotta
over EasyTier). Fetched at runtime by TerracottaNodeList so a dead relay node can be
replaced WITHOUT shipping a new APK - edit this file, merge to main, and every client
picks it up on its next host/join. Entries are tried in order; the app additionally
TCP/HTTP-probes each one and reorders live-first before handing at most 6 to EasyTier.
IMPORTANT: a shared node is just an EasyTier network. Two peers only discover each
other if they have a node in common, so keep the top entries stable - changing them
breaks sessions between clients that cached an older copy.
URIs: tcp:// udp:// ws:// wss:// quic:// wg:// faketcp:// http:// https://

nodes.note: EasyTier's own documented shared node (EasyTier README).
